067d431af467.zh: 全梯度下降以 $\mathcal{O}(1/t)$ 漸進到達精確最小值，固定步長 SGD 卻在最優點附近一個 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ 鄰域內永遠停滯漫步。透視命題 2 與命題 3、壓扁噪聲帶的遞減步長（$1/t$ 與 $1/\sqrt{t}$），以及深度學習欣然接受殘差的精度 vs 算力大取捨。
067d431af467.en: Full gradient descent approaches the exact minimum asymptotically at $\mathcal{O}(1/t)$, while fixed-step SGD stagnates forever, wandering in an $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ neighborhood around the optimum. A close look at Propositions 2 and 3, at the diminishing step sizes ($1/t$ and $1/\sqrt{t}$) that flatten the noise band, and at the great accuracy-vs-compute tradeoff in which deep learning happily accepts the residual.

01e774d687a9.zh:
「SGD 每次都在前進，為何永遠到不了最優解？」 全梯度下降保證 $\mathcal{O}(1/t) \to 0$ 精確登頂，固定步長 SGD 卻受困於 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ 停滯帶無法自拔——深度學習為何欣然擁抱這份「不精確」？
SGD keeps taking active steps, yet never reaches the exact optimum—why does fixed-rate SGD stagnate in an O(η) band, and why does deep learning willingly embrace it?
01e774d687a9.en: “SGD moves forward at every step, so why does it never reach the optimum?” Full gradient descent is guaranteed to reach the summit exactly, $\mathcal{O}(1/t) \to 0$, while fixed-step SGD is stuck in an $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ stagnation band it can never escape. Why does deep learning happily embrace this “imprecision”?

11a2db06e1d4.zh: 前面我們介紹了 SGD 與 Mini-batch SGD 在實務中的巨大工程威力，但一個本質上的理論問題尚未回答：它們到底能收斂得多快？跟傳統的全梯度下降（Full Gradient Descent）在本質上有何不同？
11a2db06e1d4.en: Earlier we introduced the enormous engineering power of SGD and mini-batch SGD in practice, but one fundamental theoretical question remains unanswered: how fast can they actually converge? And how do they differ in essence from traditional full gradient descent?

2308709d99c2.zh: 本節藉由統計最佳化領域的命題 2（全梯度收斂性）與命題 3（隨機梯度收斂性），將兩者的誤差上界並排比較，嚴格揭示固定學習率下 SGD 的「停滯現象（Stagnation Phenomenon）」，並為深度學習的學習率排程與工程折衷提供堅實的理論基石。
2308709d99c2.en: Using Proposition 2 (convergence of the full gradient) and Proposition 3 (convergence of the stochastic gradient) from statistical optimization, this section compares the error upper bounds of the two side by side, rigorously reveals the “stagnation phenomenon” of SGD under a fixed learning rate, and provides a solid theoretical foundation for learning-rate scheduling and engineering tradeoffs in deep learning.

9dcaee01157e.en: To make the loss gap $f(\boldsymbol{w}) - f^* \le \epsilon$, how many steps does full gradient descent need? And how many does SGD need? The convergence rate directly determines the theoretical lower bound on training time.

04fdf81d49c1.zh: 考慮凸且可微的目標函式 $f(\cdot)$，假設其梯度滿足 $L$-Lipschitz 連續（即 $L$-smooth：$\|\nabla f(\boldsymbol{x}) - \nabla f(\boldsymbol{y})\|_2 \leq L \|\boldsymbol{x} - \boldsymbol{y}\|_2$）。設 $f^*$ 為全域最小值、$\boldsymbol{w}^*$ 為對應的最優參數點。從初始點 $\boldsymbol{w}^{(0)}$ 出發，採用適當步長 $\eta \leq 1/L$ 經 $t$ 次全梯度迭代後（式 (31)）：
04fdf81d49c1.en: Consider a convex, differentiable objective function $f(\cdot)$ whose gradient is assumed to be $L$-Lipschitz continuous (i.e., $L$-smooth: $\|\nabla f(\boldsymbol{x}) - \nabla f(\boldsymbol{y})\|_2 \leq L \|\boldsymbol{x} - \boldsymbol{y}\|_2$). Let $f^*$ be the global minimum and $\boldsymbol{w}^*$ the corresponding optimal parameter point. Starting from the initial point $\boldsymbol{w}^{(0)}$ and using a suitable step size $\eta \leq 1/L$, after $t$ full-gradient iterations (Eq. (31)):

4fef3a285e9d.zh: 核心重點：當迭代次數 $t \rightarrow \infty$ 時，分母 $t+1 \to \infty$，使得誤差上界嚴格趨近於 0——全梯度下降能精確收斂到最優解！
4fef3a285e9d.en: Key point: as the number of iterations $t \rightarrow \infty$, the denominator $t+1 \to \infty$, so the error upper bound goes strictly to 0. Full gradient descent converges exactly to the optimum!

62dd389553b8.zh: 式 (31) 確立了傳統凸最佳化的黃金準則。全梯度下降在每一步都計算了全體資料集 $n$ 個樣本的合力方向，方向完全確定且無任何隨機性。伴隨著步數累積，損失差距以 $\mathcal{O}(1/t)$ 的速率單調遞減，直到精確抵達理論零誤差。 Under L-smoothness and convexity, full gradient descent evaluates the true gradient across all n training samples. This deterministic direction guarantees monotonic decay with an O(1/t) bound that asymptotically vanishes to zero as t approaches infinity.
62dd389553b8.en: Eq. (31) establishes the golden rule of traditional convex optimization. At every step, full gradient descent computes the combined direction over all $n$ samples of the dataset; the direction is completely determined, with no randomness at all. As steps accumulate, the loss gap decreases monotonically at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(1/t)$ until it reaches exactly the theoretical zero error.

e9d17b038936.zh: 將 $t \to \infty$ 的極限同時施加於命題 2 與命題 3，便能清楚看見兩種最佳化正規化的分水嶺：
e9d17b038936.en: Applying the limit $t \to \infty$ to both Proposition 2 and Proposition 3 clearly shows the watershed between the two optimization paradigms:

f1d6f4d4b329.zh:
固定步長 SGD 的漸進極限（式 (34) & (36)）：
$$ \lim _{t \rightarrow \infty} \mathbb{E}\left[f\left(\boldsymbol{w}^{(t+1)}\right)-f^{*}\right] \leq \lim _{t \rightarrow \infty} \mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{t}+\eta\right)=\mathcal{O}(\eta) $$ 全梯度下降的漸進極限（式 (31)）：
$$ \lim _{t \rightarrow \infty} f\left(\boldsymbol{w}^{(t+1)}\right)-f^{*} \leq \lim _{t \rightarrow \infty} \mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{t}\right)=0 $$
f1d6f4d4b329.en:
Asymptotic limit of fixed-step SGD (Eqs. (34) & (36)):
$$ \lim _{t \rightarrow \infty} \mathbb{E}\left[f\left(\boldsymbol{w}^{(t+1)}\right)-f^{*}\right] \leq \lim _{t \rightarrow \infty} \mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{t}+\eta\right)=\mathcal{O}(\eta) $$ Asymptotic limit of full gradient descent (Eq. (31)):
$$ \lim _{t \rightarrow \infty} f\left(\boldsymbol{w}^{(t+1)}\right)-f^{*} \leq \lim _{t \rightarrow \infty} \mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1}{t}\right)=0 $$

04380c3c136e.zh: 也就是說：固定步長 SGD 永遠無法精確到達最優解！ 它會在最優點附近一個大小為 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ 的鄰域內停滯（stagnate）並終身來回震盪。步長 $\eta$ 越大，停滯帶越厚；步長越小，停滯帶越薄，但前期收斂越慢。
04380c3c136e.en: In other words: fixed-step SGD can never reach the optimum exactly! It will stagnate in a neighborhood of size $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ around the optimum and oscillate back and forth there for the rest of its life. The larger the step size $\eta$, the thicker the stagnation band; the smaller the step size, the thinner the band, but the slower the early convergence.

e72c973aab5f.zh: 為什麼會發生停滯？因為每一步只抽樣一個（或一小批）資料，計算出的隨機梯度 $\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w})$ 雖然在期望值上等於真實梯度 $\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w})$，但當參數逼近最優點 $\boldsymbol{w}^*$ 時，真實梯度 $\|\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w})\| \to 0$，而單樣本梯度範數卻因為個體差異依然保持在 $\beta^2$ 水平。固定步長 $\eta$ 無法消除這份隨機噪聲，直接將其放大成參數空間中的布朗運動，形成永不消逝的停滯震盪帶。 Why stagnation happens: Near the optimal point, the true gradient vanishes to zero, but the stochastic gradient retains non-zero variance beta squared. With a fixed step size eta, this persistent noise propels the parameter into a permanent random walk inside an O(eta) neighborhood.
e72c973aab5f.en:
Why does stagnation happen? Because each step samples only one data point (or a small batch), the computed stochastic gradient $
abla f_i( oldsymbol{w})$ equals the true gradient $
abla f( oldsymbol{w})$ in expectation, but as the parameters approach the optimum $ oldsymbol{w}^*$, the true gradient $\|
abla f( oldsymbol{w})\| 	o 0$, while the single-sample gradient norm stays at the $ eta^2$ level because of individual differences between samples. A fixed step size $\eta$ cannot eliminate this random noise; it amplifies it directly into a Brownian motion in parameter space, forming a stagnation oscillation band that never goes away.

ec7300697171.zh: 直覺上，只要最佳化器持續沿著負梯度方向邁步，且步長固定不變，總該能摸到最優谷底。然而，隨機性徹底顛覆了這個直覺：
ec7300697171.en: Intuitively, as long as the optimizer keeps stepping along the negative gradient with a fixed step size, it should eventually touch the bottom of the optimal valley. However, randomness completely overturns this intuition:

2753f9b8a553.zh: 每步抽樣的侷限：每次僅計算一個小批次，隨機梯度包含非零噪聲項 $\boldsymbol{\xi}_t$。
2753f9b8a553.en: The limitation of per-step sampling: each step computes only one small batch, so the stochastic gradient contains a nonzero noise term $\boldsymbol{\xi}_t$.

235ed4b9d4b9.zh: 噪聲無法平均：固定步長 $\eta$ 使隨機跳躍步幅維持在 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$，即便已經身處谷底，也會被隨機噪聲一腳踹出！
235ed4b9d4b9.en: The noise cannot be averaged out: a fixed step size $\eta$ keeps the random jumps at a stride of $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$, so even when it is already at the bottom of the valley, the random noise kicks it right out!

f54219d77689.zh: 厚度由步長決定：停滯帶厚度完全正比於 $\eta$。步長越大，在帶子內震盪的幅度越劇烈。
f54219d77689.en: The thickness is set by the step size: the thickness of the stagnation band is directly proportional to $\eta$. The larger the step size, the more violent the oscillation inside the band.

8003cf6c9ec8.zh: 破局唯一解：若想讓極限誤差真正抵達 0，必須在訓練後期將步長主動衰減，把帶子「壓扁」！
8003cf6c9ec8.en: The only way out: if you want the limiting error to truly reach 0, you must actively decay the step size late in training and “flatten” the band!

0998681ee559.zh: 07 / 破局之道 · Flattening the Band
0998681ee559.en: 07 / The Way Out · Flattening the Band

c77df1141e5e.zh: 壓扁帶子：遞減步長 $\eta_t = 1/t$ 或 $1/\sqrt{t}$ 如何壓縮噪聲帶換取收斂 Flattening the Band: How Diminishing Step Sizes Compress Stochastic Noise for True Convergence
c77df1141e5e.en: Flattening the Band: How Diminishing Step Sizes $\eta_t = 1/t$ or $1/\sqrt{t}$ Compress the Noise Band in Exchange for Convergence

2bed14b52390.zh: 將停滯帶壓扁為「收縮漏斗」的數學機制
2bed14b52390.en: The mathematical mechanism that flattens the stagnation band into a “shrinking funnel”

c694f5d28ced.zh: 既然停滯帶的厚度是 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$，那麼讓長期殘差趨近於 0 的直接思路，就是讓步長隨迭代次數 $t$ 動態衰減！經典文獻給出了兩組標準的衰減步長排程策略：
c694f5d28ced.en: Since the thickness of the stagnation band is $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$, the direct way to make the long-run residual approach 0 is to make the step size decay dynamically with the number of iterations $t$! The classic literature gives two standard decaying step-size schedules:

819747e58244.zh: 在強凸（Strongly Convex）目標函式下，步長以 $1/\tau$ 遞減能讓 SGD 的 $1/t$ 項主導整體收斂，壓平噪聲帶，達成 $\mathcal{O}(1/t)$ 的漸進收斂率，長期誤差精確趨近 0。
819747e58244.en: For strongly convex objective functions, a step size decreasing as $1/\tau$ lets SGD's $1/t$ term dominate the overall convergence, flattens the noise band, and achieves an asymptotic convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(1/t)$, with the long-run error going exactly to 0.

cf0f1ef91c87.zh: 在一般凸（Convex）且 Lipschitz 連續目標函式下，$1/\sqrt{\tau}$ 步長是最穩健的理論選擇，保證收斂率為 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{t})$，既不會過早凍結參數，又能將殘差帶壓縮至零。
cf0f1ef91c87.en: For general convex, Lipschitz-continuous objective functions, the $1/\sqrt{\tau}$ step size is the most robust theoretical choice; it guarantees a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{t})$, neither freezing the parameters too early nor failing to compress the residual band to zero.

bf9fddb2b273.zh: Robbins-Monro 隨機逼近兩大黃金條件（1951）
bf9fddb2b273.en: The two golden conditions of Robbins-Monro stochastic approximation (1951)

70b52eba22e6.zh: 古典隨機逼近理論證明，遞減步長必須同時滿足「發散條件」與「平方收斂條件」：
70b52eba22e6.en: Classical stochastic approximation theory proves that a diminishing step size must satisfy both a “divergence condition” and a “square-summability condition”:

870d2487713b.zh:
條件 1（$\sum \eta = \infty$）：步長總和必須發散，確保模型有足夠的「續航力」從任何遙遠的初始點出發走完全程抵達最優點。
條件 2（$\sum \eta^2 < \infty$）：步長平方和必須收斂，確保累積的隨機噪聲方差最終能被徹底消解，不會在無窮時間裡引發能量爆炸。
870d2487713b.en:
Condition 1 ($\sum \eta = \infty$): the sum of the step sizes must diverge, so the model has enough “range” to travel all the way from any distant initial point to the optimum.
Condition 2 ($\sum \eta^2 < \infty$): the sum of the squared step sizes must converge, so the accumulated variance of the random noise is eventually dissolved completely and does not cause an energy explosion over infinite time.

256b906548bb.zh: 08 / 工程權衡 · Cost vs Accuracy Tradeoff
256b906548bb.en: 08 / Engineering Tradeoffs · Cost vs Accuracy Tradeoff

c463e101dc76.zh: 精度與計算成本天平：深度學習為何欣然接受 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ The Cost-Accuracy Tradeoff: Why Deep Learning Gladly Embraces the O(η) Optimization Residual
c463e101dc76.en: The Balance of Accuracy and Computational Cost: Why Deep Learning Happily Accepts $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$

192e84fd57c6.zh: 全梯度每走一步需遍歷全集 $n$ 筆樣本，耗費 $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot d)$ 次浮點運算；當 $n=10^7$ 時，一步需數小時。而 SGD/Mini-batch 每步僅耗費 $\mathcal{O}(B \cdot d)$（$B=128$），在全梯度走 1 步的時間裡，SGD 已經更新了 10 萬步！
192e84fd57c6.en: Each step of the full gradient must sweep all $n$ samples, costing $\mathcal{O}(n \cdot d)$ floating-point operations; when $n=10^7$, one step takes hours. SGD/mini-batch costs only $\mathcal{O}(B \cdot d)$ per step ($B=128$): in the time full gradient descent takes 1 step, SGD has already made 100,000 updates!

7a6cfb04ac43.zh: 2. 泛化誤差 vs 最佳化誤差

af04d0e59ed4.zh: 機器學習的目標是測試集泛化能力，而非訓練集數值精確度。統計學習理論指出，有限樣本的泛化誤差下限約為 $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{n}) \approx 10^{-3}$，花費龐大算力把訓練損失從 $10^{-3}$ 最佳化到 $10^{-9}$ 完全是毫無意義的過擬合。
af04d0e59ed4.en: The goal of machine learning is generalization on the test set, not numerical accuracy on the training set. Statistical learning theory indicates that the lower bound of the generalization error for a finite sample is about $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{n}) \approx 10^{-3}$; spending enormous compute to optimize the training loss from $10^{-3}$ down to $10^{-9}$ is completely meaningless overfitting.

74f414dfb4c3.zh: 3. 隨機噪聲的隱式正則化
74f414dfb4c3.en: 3. The implicit regularization of random noise

2fe1bba178cd.zh: 在非凸深度神經網路中，固定步長的 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ 抖動並非純粹的負面缺陷！它扮演了隨機退火（Simulated Annealing）角色，幫助參數跳出高泛化誤差的尖銳局部極小（Sharp Minima），墜入具備強泛化魯棒性的平坦谷底（Flat Minima）。
2fe1bba178cd.en: In non-convex deep neural networks, the $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ jitter of a fixed step size is not purely a negative defect! It plays the role of simulated annealing, helping the parameters jump out of sharp local minima with high generalization error and fall into flat minima with strong, robust generalization.

5490f46c4acb.zh: 現代訓練（如 Cosine Decay、Warmup-Decay）採用混合智慧：前期用較大的固定步長 $\eta$ 快速下潛，享受高速逼近的好處；後期在收斂瓶頸處執行步長退火（LR Decay），將停滯帶順勢壓扁，達成高精度與高效率的完美統一。
5490f46c4acb.en: Modern training (e.g., cosine decay, warmup-decay) uses a hybrid wisdom: early on, a larger fixed step size $\eta$ dives down fast, enjoying the benefit of a rapid approach; later, at the convergence bottleneck, learning-rate annealing (LR decay) is applied to flatten the stagnation band along the way, achieving a perfect union of high accuracy and high efficiency.

d5cd9875e608.zh: 收斂檢查困境：單樣本梯度監控與實務策略 The Stopping Dilemma: Single-Sample Gradient Monitoring & Practical Stopping Criteria
d5cd9875e608.en: The Convergence-Check Dilemma: Single-Sample Gradient Monitoring and Practical Strategies

4e06faf056f2.zh: SGD 收斂判定難題：全梯度哪裡找？
4e06faf056f2.en: The SGD convergence-test problem: where do you get the full gradient?

07076b7a921f.zh: 在古典數值最佳化中，全梯度下降擁有非常優雅的停止條件：檢驗全梯度範數是否小於容許閾值：$\|\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w}^{(t)})\|_2 \le \epsilon$。一旦滿足，即可宣佈演算法精確收斂。然而在 SGD 中：
07076b7a921f.en: In classical numerical optimization, full gradient descent has a very elegant stopping condition: check whether the full-gradient norm is below a tolerance threshold: $\|\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w}^{(t)})\|_2 \le \epsilon$. Once this holds, the algorithm can be declared exactly converged. In SGD, however:

6aaec29b3281.zh: 全梯度無法取得：如果每一步都要遍歷全部 $n$ 筆樣本計算 $\|\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w})\|$ 來檢查是否收斂，就徹底抵消了 SGD 單步輕量的核心優勢！
6aaec29b3281.en: The full gradient is unavailable: if every step had to sweep all $n$ samples to compute $\|\nabla f(\boldsymbol{w})\|$ to check convergence, that would completely cancel SGD's core advantage of lightweight steps!

978ad122d3e1.zh: 單樣本梯度不可靠：單一樣本或批次的梯度 $\|\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w})\|$ 受隨機噪聲影響劇烈，即便模型早已身處最優點，單樣本梯度範數也不可能為零。
978ad122d3e1.en: Single-sample gradients are unreliable: the gradient of a single sample or batch, $\|\nabla f_i(\boldsymbol{w})\|$, is heavily affected by random noise; even when the model is already at the optimum, the single-sample gradient norm cannot be zero.

447d561220ff.zh: 實務替代策略：實務中改為監控驗證集損失（Validation Loss）平臺期、對梯度或權重計算指數移動平均（EMA），或搭配學習率排程按固定 Epoch 拍板訓練。
447d561220ff.en: Practical alternatives: in practice one instead monitors the plateau of the validation loss, computes an exponential moving average (EMA) of the gradients or weights, or ends training after a fixed number of epochs together with a learning-rate schedule.

9660cf534bbb.en: The Master's Four Iron Laws: The Limits and Engineering Wisdom of Stochastic Optimization

566930dc258f.zh: 全梯度下降擁有確定性的神聖保證：只要函式平滑且凸，步長小於 $1/L$，時間趨近無窮時誤差必然嚴格歸零。這是數值微積分的最高理想。
566930dc258f.en: Full gradient descent has a sacred deterministic guarantee: as long as the function is smooth and convex and the step size is below $1/L$, the error must go strictly to zero as time goes to infinity. This is the highest ideal of numerical calculus.

a4230b8b44e1.zh: 二、殘差帶囚律 (Residual Band Captivity)
a4230b8b44e1.en: II. The Law of Residual-Band Captivity

b03f32ba5bc5.zh: 固定步長 SGD 終其一生無法突破隨機方差的桎梏。一旦落入 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ 停滯帶，任何多餘的迭代都不過是在噪聲囚籠中的布朗漫步。
b03f32ba5bc5.en: Fixed-step SGD can never, in its whole life, break the shackles of stochastic variance. Once it falls into the $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ stagnation band, every extra iteration is nothing more than a Brownian stroll inside a cage of noise.

b2c811d0dc9e.zh: 三、衰減收縮律 (Decay Compression Law)
b2c811d0dc9e.en: III. The Law of Decay Compression

fa57dbf9cdaf.zh: 步長是停滯帶的唯一閥門。依循 Robbins-Monro 條件實施步長退火，即是在時空中施展壓縮魔法，將噪聲走廊壓成一條直指最優點的細線。
fa57dbf9cdaf.en: The step size is the only valve of the stagnation band. Annealing the step size according to the Robbins-Monro conditions is casting a compression spell across time, squeezing the noise corridor into a thin line that points straight at the optimum.

70634b980073.en: IV. The Law of Cost-Accuracy Balance

c3d38f66db66.zh: 深度學習的核心哲學是「在有限的算力預算內換取最廣泛的泛化能力」。欣然接受 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ 的微小殘差，換來十萬倍的更新頻率，是機器學習最偉大的工程妥協。
c3d38f66db66.en: The core philosophy of deep learning is “to buy the broadest generalization ability within a finite compute budget.” Happily accepting a tiny $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ residual in exchange for a hundred-thousand-fold update frequency is the greatest engineering compromise in machine learning.

🧪 實測大挑戰：
1. 困於停滯帶：選擇「固定步長 SGD」，點選「連續 20 步」數次（走滿 60-80 步）。觀察軌跡跌入紅色 $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ 停滯帶後，即便持續迭代數百步，誤差依然在帶內震盪無法歸零！
2. 壓扁帶子破局：切換至「衰減步長 SGD (η₀ / √t)」，觀察紅色帶子如何隨迭代次數演進而逐漸「壓扁收縮」，強迫隨機軌跡穿透雜訊阻隔，穩步貼近綠色零點線！

🧪 The hands-on challenge:
1. Stuck in the stagnation band: choose “Fixed-step SGD” and click “20 steps in a row” several times (60-80 steps in all). Watch the trajectory fall into the red $\mathcal{O}(\eta)$ stagnation band: even if you keep iterating for hundreds of steps, the error keeps oscillating inside the band and never reaches zero!
2. Flatten the band and break out: switch to “Diminishing-step SGD (η₀ / √t)” and watch how the red band gradually “flattens and shrinks” as the iterations go on, forcing the random trajectory through the noise barrier and steadily closer to the green zero line!
3. Full-gradient comparison: choose “Full gradient descent” and watch the blue line descend smoothly and monotonically to zero, confirming the asymptotic zero-error theorem of Proposition 2!
